title: Soldiers of the five clans
changes: Clan patrols and sieges now field their own soldiers: amber Wardens with kettle helms, Redfang raiders in red cloaks, rusted bone legionaries of the Ossuary Host, pick-wielding Hide-Kin diggers and indigo Veiled acolytes.
Each clan's column is led by an officer: a plumed Warden captain, a Redfang brute, a bone captain, a tusked Hide-Kin war-chief and a masked adept.
Soldiers who fall in a siege now stagger and drop to the ground.
